body.name: Geometric-mixing frontier and independent-design comparator
body.construction:
\[
 R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}
 :=\left\{\frac{\log(T\vee2)}{T}\right\}^{2\lambda/d},
 \qquad
 R_{\star,\beta}
 :=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sm}}
   \vee R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}},
\]
where
\[
 R_{\mathrm{tr}}:=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s},
 \qquad
 R_{\mathrm{sm}}:=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s^2
 (Tn_s)^{-2\lambda/(2\lambda+d)},
 \qquad
 R_{\mathrm{don}}:=N^{-\kappa}.
\]
For an independent-design or fixed-query comparator, retain
\[
 R_{\mathrm{sp}}:=T^{-2\lambda/d},
 \qquad
 R_\star:=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sm}}
 \vee R_{\mathrm{sp}}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}.
\]
